decisions.reason: Identifies the dsh web-host node.exe PID 42432 as the koffi.node holder; explains the mapped DLL stays locked until process exit so npm's copyfile/reify gets EBUSY; also notes the session worker as a second holder.

Browser refresh only reloads the SPA served by PID 42432 and releases nothing; ordered procedure stop host/workers, verify with tasklist, install, verify version, restart — limited to dsh processes, not unrelated Node.

Bare name follows latest = 0.1.1-rc.2 (next same), alpha = 0.1.2-alpha.5; explains npm installs exactly what the tag resolves to, silently replacing the installed prerelease rather than preserving/upgrading it.

Gives npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-alpha.5 plus the TUI package (pinned) after stopping the host, combined and split variants, dsh --version must print alpha.5, then restart; @alpha discussed as a floating alternative only.

README rules: never ship a bare core name, pin exact tested version when a plugin command also installs dsh, pin the plugin too, avoid silently following latest over an existing prerelease, plus verification and stop-first steps.
